verdict.rationale: Datalab offers BAA/DPA on Team plan and on-prem/air-gapped Enterprise options implying data control, plus file storage/checkpoint features, but there is no explicit documentation of user-facing data retention windows, deletion controls/APIs, or a way for a self-serve user to purge stored documents/checkpoints. missing for 10: explicit retention period disclosure, self-service deletion/purge API or dashboard control, documentation of default data lifecycle for uploaded files and checkpoints.
